title: Smooth double-integral Poincaré estimate on B_r (0 < r ≤ 1)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every C^1 function φ : ℝ^n → ℝ and every r with 0 < r ≤ 1: ∫⁻_{x ∈ B_r} ∫⁻_{y ∈ B_r} ‖φ(x) − φ(y)‖ₑ² dy dx ≤ 2^{n+2} · |B_1| · ∫⁻_{B_r} ‖∇φ‖ₑ², where B_s = ball(0, s), |B_1| is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball and ∇φ is Mathlib's gradient φ (lintegrals in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖φ x - φ y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (n + 2) * volume (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖gradient φ x‖ₑ ^ 2
